diagram:
flowchart TD
  TRIG["Independent weekly pg_cron or owner run"] --> INPUTS["GDELT headlines first\nAlpha Vantage news reserve only"]
  INPUTS --> THEMES["LLM proposes up to 3 themes\nConfigured model; Groq default"]
  THEMES --> CAND["Up to 2 US equities per theme\n6 names maximum"]
  CAND --> VERIFY{"Shared fundamentals resolver confirms ticker?"}
  VERIFY -->|No| QUAR["Quarantine invalid candidate"]
  VERIFY -->|Yes| ADD["Owner-scoped watchlist row\nsource llm_theme; 7-day expiry"]
  ADD --> ALERT["Write operational alert"]
  ADD -.-> RESEARCH["Later normal ResearchAgent run\nfull deterministic gates"]

TRIG.label: Independent trigger
TRIG.description: Runs from its own weekly pg_cron job and also accepts an authenticated owner run. It is no longer awaited inside the US research cron.
TRIG.addReason: Thematic discovery needs a bounded cadence.
TRIG.changeReason: Decoupled from ResearchAgent so scout latency and quota use cannot suppress the research batch.

INPUTS.label: Free-first news inputs
INPUTS.description: Uses broad GDELT headlines first. Cached Alpha Vantage NEWS_SENTIMENT is fallback; TOP_GAINERS_LOSERS is used only if neither path yields headlines.
INPUTS.addReason: Theme proposals require current market context.
INPUTS.changeReason: Moved the normal path off the shared 25-per-day Alpha Vantage allowance.

THEMES.label: Propose themes
THEMES.description: The per-flow configured LLM proposes at most three distinct themes. The default is Groq llama-3.3-70b-versatile. This output is discovery, not a score or trade instruction.
THEMES.addReason: Themes surface names outside the static watchlist.
THEMES.changeReason: Clarified the configured model and non-money-path role.

CAND.label: Bound candidates
CAND.description: Takes at most two proposed US equities per theme, with a hard maximum of six names per run.

VERIFY.label: Verify ticker
VERIFY.description: The shared US fundamentals resolver must resolve the symbol before insertion. Finnhub, Yahoo, and FMP precede cached Alpha Vantage reserve data.
VERIFY.addReason: A deterministic check prevents invented or unavailable tickers from entering research.
VERIFY.changeReason: Replaced an Alpha Vantage-only check with the shared redundant fundamentals resolver.

QUAR.label: Quarantine
QUAR.description: Unverified symbols are returned in the quarantined list and never written to the watchlist.
QUAR.addReason: The rejection path must remain auditable.

ADD.label: Write expiring discovery
ADD.description: Writes owner-scoped watchlist rows with source llm_theme, reason, theme, explicit market, auto_added, and a seven-day expiry. Existing human-managed rows are not overwritten.
ADD.addReason: Discovery needs a bounded, attributable handoff to research.
ADD.changeReason: Documented owner scope, overwrite protection, and expiry semantics.

ALERT.label: Operational alert
ALERT.description: Writes an informational alert when names are added and a warning if the watchlist write fails.
ALERT.addReason: A quiet run must be distinguishable from a failed write.

RESEARCH.label: Later deterministic research
RESEARCH.description: A subsequent normal ResearchAgent run may select the names. Theme Scout does not score or trade them, and no candidate bypasses evidence, score, direction, or execution gates.
RESEARCH.addReason: The boundary between generative discovery and deterministic decisions must be explicit.
RESEARCH.changeReason: The independent job no longer injects names into the same research invocation.

history.label: Decouple Theme Scout from ResearchAgent
history.reason: The scout now runs independently, uses GDELT first, reserves Alpha Vantage for fallback, and hands discoveries to later normal research rather than consuming the active research run.
